tail:
Batch 60 now has **19 A page items and 4 B page examples**, with supplier-first levels and matching manifests. I added a local normal-trace surjectivity proof to support the DPG kernel argument. The two-dimensional trace bridge is proved locally; it does not use the PE09 carrier’s three-dimensional trace result.

**Step 1 records:** 21 items are ready and 2 are escalated. The connected-domain Poisson graph inf-sup claim and its practical DPG corollary retain their full statements, but remain unproved: the inspected source proof assumes simple connectivity. Details are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-60.notes.md) and [cross-batch dependency record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-60.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

The assigned checks passed: proof layout (23 items, 52 steps), precheck (19 proofs), strict proof contracts (19/19), source fetch (10/10), coverage (2 pages, 41 harvested results), content policy, and the full run’s item dependency-level check. The separate batch dependency-level check could not parse an unrelated Batch 71 carrier: [def-na-finite-state-discounted-bellman-system.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-na-finite-state-discounted-bellman-system.md), which has an unquoted source title in its frontmatter.

The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-pdes-and-spatial-discretization/least-squares-fem-and-practical-dpg.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-pdes-and-spatial-discretization/least-squares-fem-and-practical-dpg-examples.md), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-60.proof-contracts.json), and source evidence are ready for owner reconciliation. Readiness records are authoring evidence, not independent proof approval.
